The following events took place in '''16 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Battle of Doornik-319|Beginning]] of the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>
*[[H'kig]] community on [[J't'p'tan]] was hidden by a [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] illusion.
*A squad of [[E4 baron droid]]s overthrow the administrators of the only settlement on the planet [[Arzid]].<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
